verses.text: Why, O LORD, do You stand far off? Why do You hide in times of trouble?

xrefs.text: For the choirmaster. To the tune of “The Doe of the Dawn.” A Psalm of David. My God, my God, why have You forsaken me? Why are You so far from saving me, so far from my words of groaning?
Hide not Your face from me, nor turn away Your servant in anger. You have been my helper; do not leave me or forsake me, O God of my salvation.
For the choirmaster. A Psalm of David. How long, O LORD? Will You forget me forever? How long will You hide Your face from me?
Why do You hide Your face and forget our affliction and oppression?
O Hope of Israel, its Savior in times of distress, why are You like a stranger in the land, like a traveler who stays but a night?

verses.text: In pride the wicked pursue the needy; let them be caught in the schemes they devise.

xrefs.text: By the sins of their mouths and the words of their lips, let them be trapped in their pride, in the curses and lies they utter.
Let not the foot of the proud come against me, nor the hand of the wicked drive me away.
His trouble recoils on himself, and his violence falls on his own head.
The iniquities of a wicked man entrap him; the cords of his sin entangle him.
May lying lips be silenced— lips that speak with arrogance against the righteous, full of pride and contempt.

verses.text: For the wicked man boasts in the cravings of his heart; he blesses the greedy and reviles the LORD.

xrefs.text: They pour out arrogant words; all workers of iniquity boast.
Then I will say to myself, “You have plenty of good things laid up for many years. Take it easy. Eat, drink, and be merry!
whose buyers slaughter them without remorse. Those who sell them say, ‘Blessed be the LORD, for I am rich!’ Even their own shepherds have no compassion on them.
Can I forget any longer, O house of the wicked, the treasures of wickedness and the short ephah, which is accursed?
They trust in their wealth and boast in their great riches.

verses.text: In his pride the wicked man does not seek Him; in all his schemes there is no God.

xrefs.text: For the choirmaster. Of David. The fool says in his heart, “There is no God.” They are corrupt; their acts are vile. There is no one who does good.
Furthermore, since they did not see fit to acknowledge God, He gave them up to a depraved mind, to do what ought not to be done.
Repent, therefore, of your wickedness, and pray to the Lord. Perhaps He will forgive you for the intent of your heart.
Then the LORD saw that the wickedness of man was great upon the earth, and that every inclination of the thoughts of his heart was altogether evil all the time.
then your heart will become proud, and you will forget the LORD your God who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of slavery.

verses.text: He is secure in his ways at all times; Your lofty judgments are far from him; he sneers at all his foes.

xrefs.text: O LORD, Your hand is upraised, but they do not see it. They will see Your zeal for Your people and be put to shame. The fire set for Your enemies will consume them!
“For the cause of the oppressed and for the groaning of the needy, I will now arise,” says the LORD. “I will bring safety to him who yearns.”
Whoever is wise, let him understand these things; whoever is discerning, let him know them. For the ways of the LORD are right, and the righteous walk in them but the rebellious stumble in them.
How great are Your works, O LORD, how deep are Your thoughts!

Now the king and his men marched to Jerusalem against the Jebusites who inhabited the land. The Jebusites said to David: “You will never get in here. Even the blind and lame can repel you.” For they thought, “David cannot get in here.”

verses.text: He says to himself, “I will not be moved; from age to age I am free of distress.”

“Come, let me get the wine, let us imbibe the strong drink, and tomorrow will be like today, only far better!”

For the choirmaster. Of David. In the LORD I take refuge. How then can you say to me: “Flee like a bird to your mountain!
While people are saying, “Peace and security, destruction will come upon them suddenly, like labor pains on a pregnant woman, and they will not escape.

verses.text: His mouth is full of cursing, deceit, and violence; trouble and malice are under his tongue.

xrefs.text: Behold, the wicked man travails with evil; he conceives trouble and births falsehood.
May the heads of those who surround me be covered in the trouble their lips have caused.
They sharpen their tongues like snakes; the venom of vipers is on their lips. Selah
who sharpen their tongues like swords and aim their bitter words like arrows,

verses.text: He lies in wait near the villages; in ambush he slays the innocent; his eyes watch in stealth for the helpless.

xrefs.text: With his own spear You pierced his head, when his warriors stormed out to scatter us, gloating as though ready to secretly devour the weak.
“But your eyes and heart are set on nothing except your own dishonest gain, on shedding innocent blood, on practicing extortion and oppression.”

verses.text: He lies in wait like a lion in a thicket; he lurks to seize the oppressed; he catches the lowly in his net.

xrefs.text: like a lion greedy for prey, like a young lion lurking in ambush.
See how they lie in wait for me. Fierce men conspire against me for no transgression or sin of my own, O LORD.
The godly man has perished from the earth; there is no one upright among men. They all lie in wait for blood; they hunt one another with a net.
All my bones will exclaim, “Who is like You, O LORD, who delivers the afflicted from the aggressor, the poor and needy from the robber?”
He saves the needy from the sword in their mouth and from the clutches of the powerful.

verses.text: They are crushed and beaten down; the helpless fall prey to his strength.

“May you be blessed by the LORD,” replied Saul, “for you have had compassion on me.

verses.text: He says to himself, “God has forgotten; He hides His face and never sees.”

xrefs.text: “Son of man,” He said to me, “do you see what the elders of the house of Israel are doing in the darkness, each at the shrine of his own idol? For they are saying, ‘The LORD does not see us; the LORD has forsaken the land.’”
They say, “The LORD does not see; the God of Jacob pays no heed.”
The wicked say, “How can God know? Does the Most High have knowledge?”

verses.text: Arise, O LORD! Lift up Your hand, O God! Do not forget the helpless.

xrefs.text: Your hand will be lifted over your foes, and all your enemies will be cut off.
For the Avenger of bloodshed remembers; He does not ignore the cry of the afflicted.
Rise up, O Judge of the earth; render a reward to the proud.
“Now I will arise,” says the LORD. “Now I will lift Myself up. Now I will be exalted.
Show the wonders of Your loving devotion, You who save by Your right hand those who seek refuge from their foes.

verses.text: Why has the wicked man renounced God? He says to himself, “You will never call me to account.”

xrefs.text: Whoever listens to you listens to Me; whoever rejects you rejects Me; and whoever rejects Me rejects the One who sent Me.

Why then have you despised the command of the LORD by doing evil in His sight? You put Uriah the Hittite to the sword and took his wife as your own. You have slain him with the sword of the Ammonites.

but for a whole month — until it comes out of your nostrils and makes you nauseous— because you have rejected the LORD, who is among you, and have cried out before Him, saying, ‘Why did we ever leave Egypt?’”
Remember how the enemy has mocked You, O LORD, how a foolish people has spurned Your name.
Anyone, then, who rejects this command does not reject man but God, the very One who gives you His Holy Spirit.

verses.text: But You have regarded trouble and grief; You see to repay it by Your hand. The victim entrusts himself to You; You are the helper of the fatherless.

xrefs.text: A father of the fatherless and a defender of widows is God in His holy habitation.
The LORD protects foreigners; He sustains the fatherless and the widow, but the ways of the wicked He frustrates.
Cast your burden upon the LORD and He will sustain you; He will never let the righteous be shaken.
He executes justice for the fatherless and widow, and He loves the foreigner, giving him food and clothing.
So then, those who suffer according to God’s will should entrust their souls to their faithful Creator and continue to do good.

verses.text: Break the arm of the wicked and evildoer; call him to account for his wickedness until none is left to be found.

xrefs.text: For the arms of the wicked will be broken, but the LORD upholds the righteous.
Light is withheld from the wicked, and their upraised arm is broken.
And at that time I will search Jerusalem with lamps and punish the men settled in complacency, who say to themselves, ‘The LORD will do nothing, either good or bad.’
Put an end to the evil of the wicked, but establish the righteous, O righteous God who searches hearts and minds.
“Son of man, I have broken the arm of Pharaoh king of Egypt. See, it has not been bound up for healing, or splinted for strength to hold the sword.

verses.text: The LORD is King forever and ever; the nations perish from His land.

xrefs.text: The LORD sits enthroned over the flood; the LORD is enthroned as King forever.
But the LORD is the true God; He is the living God and eternal King. The earth quakes at His wrath, and the nations cannot endure His indignation.
Now to the King eternal, immortal, and invisible, the only God, be honor and glory forever and ever. Amen.
Like the nations that the LORD has destroyed before you, so you will perish if you do not obey the LORD your God.
Your kingdom is an everlasting kingdom, and Your dominion endures through all generations. The LORD is faithful in all His words and kind in all His actions.

verses.text: You have heard, O LORD, the desire of the humble; You will strengthen their hearts. You will incline Your ear,

xrefs.text: He fulfills the desires of those who fear Him; He hears their cry and saves them.

because your heart was tender and you humbled yourself before God when you heard His words against this place and against its people, and because you have humbled yourself before Me and have torn your clothes and wept before Me, I have heard you,’ declares the LORD.
The eyes of the LORD are on the righteous, and His ears are inclined to their cry.
For the eyes of the Lord are on the righteous, and His ears are inclined to their prayer. But the face of the Lord is against those who do evil.”
Even before they call, I will answer, and while they are still speaking, I will hear.
